narration.text: Voyager 1 is 25.6 billion kilometres from Earth.
Its signals take nearly a day to arrive.
In 2012, it became the first craft in interstellar space.
It's the most distant human-made object.
By November 2026, it will be one light-day away.
Riding along, you'd see the Sun as just a bright star.
So our farthest traveller has barely left the Sun's neighbourhood.
